message.content: Why does the task status change only after I reload the page?

content.text: The materialized projection requires client reconciliation after the asynchronous lifecycle transition.

message.content: I don't understand which part needs the reload. Explain what the browser does.

content.text: The worker saves the new task status. The browser receives no live update. Reloading makes the browser request the saved status.

message.content: So the worker saves it, but the browser only reads the saved status when I reload. That explains the delay.
What would a live update change?

content.text: A live update is a message that the server sends when the status changes. The browser would use that message to update the page.

message.content: The browser would receive the new status without another reload. I understand the proposed behavior.
